name: How do I make my kitchen sink and faucet look cohesive without making everything match too much?
description: Use one dominant finish and one accent at most, and keep the style family consistent so the space feels coordinated.

mainEntity.name: How do I make my kitchen sink and faucet look cohesive without making everything match too much?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your kitchen feels visually busy, simplify the palette: choose one dominant finish and keep the sink, faucet, and nearby hardware in the same style family. If you want contrast, keep it deliberate and limited so the sink area still feels unified.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use one dominant finish and one accent at most, and keep the style family consistent so the space feels coordinated.
